name: spl_time_weighting
description: Time weightings F, S and I of a sound level meter on the squared signal: the level after a step of the mean square, its fall after the signal stops, and the maximum I-weighted level of isolated 4 kHz tonebursts relative to the steady level (Z weighting).

parameters.detector: avg[n] = avg[n-1] + alpha (x[n]^2 - avg[n-1]), alpha = 1 - exp(-1/(fs rise)); F, S: ms = avg; I: ms[n] = avg[n] if avg[n] >= ms[n-1], else max(ms[n-1] exp(-1/(fs fall)), avg[n])
parameters.step: x = 1 from sample 0; level 10 log10(ms) at sample round(t fs) - 1 (analytically 10 log10(1 - exp(-t / rise)))
parameters.decay: x = 1 for 10 s, then 0; level at sample 10 fs - 1 + round(t fs) relative to the level at the stop (analytically -10 lg(e) t / fall = -4.343 t / fall dB)
parameters.burst: x = amp sin(2 pi f0 k / fs), k = 0..round(Tb fs)-1, after 10 ms of silence, then 200 ms of silence

references: IEC 60651:1979 (I: 35 ms rise, 1.5 s fall; single-burst responses -3.6, -8.8, -12.6 dB at 20, 5, 2 ms)
